purpose: Explain a mockup and design-system workflow for agents

required_facts.fact: One-shot generation often creates generic repeated patterns.
Mockups can communicate hierarchy before implementation.
The implementation should be reviewed page by page.
A design system records styles and placement rules.
GitHub Primer was selected as a reference.
Corrections should be added back to the system.
The approach also applies to Android interfaces.
The method still requires human review.

author_attribution: Explain the process as Alexey's supported workflow, not a universal design guarantee.
